_about: Per-package line coverage floors for shared/, measured on the offline unit suite (pytest -m unit). Ratchet rule: a floor may be raised, never lowered, except by an ADR. Policy and rationale: docs/coverage-policy.md. Enforced by scripts/check_coverage.py in the shared-coverage CI job.

excluded.performance: Load scripts (Locust, k6 driver) run in the k6 and performance jobs, not under pytest.
